name: test-explorer
description: Find, run and see the results of Jest, Vitest, node:test, pytest and Go tests: a Testing view, run buttons beside each test, failures under the failing line.

jestCommand.title: Jest Command
jestCommand.description: How to start Jest, e.g. "npx jest" or "yarn jest". Empty: the project's node_modules/.bin/jest, else npx.

vitestCommand.title: Vitest Command
vitestCommand.description: How to start Vitest. Empty: the project's node_modules/.bin/vitest, else npx.

nodeCommand.title: Node.js Command
nodeCommand.description: The node that runs node:test files. Empty: node.

pytestCommand.title: pytest Command
pytestCommand.description: How to start pytest, e.g. "poetry run pytest". Empty: the project's .venv, else python3 -m pytest.

goCommand.title: Go Command
goCommand.description: The go command that runs go test. Empty: go.

useFrameworkLists.title: Ask Frameworks for Their Tests
useFrameworkLists.description: In trusted folders, also ask Jest, Vitest, pytest and Go which tests they have, to find each-cases and parametrized tests a scan of the files can't see.

runOnSave.title: Run Tests on Save
runOnSave.description: Run a test file's tests each time you save it.
